addr-type.name: addr-type
addr-type.help: Address type of the forwarding proxy server: IP or FQDN.

options.name: ip
options.help: Use an IPv4 address for the forwarding proxy server.

options.name: ipv6
options.help: Use an IPv6 address for the forwarding proxy server.

options.name: fqdn
options.help: Use the FQDN for the forwarding proxy server.

fqdn.name: fqdn
fqdn.help: Forward server Fully Qualified Domain Name (FQDN).

port.name: port
port.help: Port number that the forwarding server expects to receive HTTP sessions on (1 - 65535, default = 3128).

healthcheck.name: healthcheck
healthcheck.help: Enable/disable forward server health checking. Attempts to connect through the remote forwarding server to a destination to verify that the forwarding server is operating normally.

monitor.name: monitor
monitor.help: URL for forward server health check monitoring (default = www.google.com).

server-down-option.name: server-down-option
server-down-option.help: Action to take when the forward server is found to be down: block sessions until the server is back up or pass sessions to their destination.

options.name: block
options.help: Block sessions until the server is back up.

options.name: pass
options.help: Pass sessions to their destination bypassing the forward server.

masquerade.name: masquerade
masquerade.help: Enable/disable use of the of the IP address of the outgoing interface as the client IP address (default = enable)

options.name: enable
options.help: Enable use of the IP address of the outgoing interface as the client IP address.

options.name: disable
options.help: Disable use of the of the IP address of the outgoing interface as the client IP address.
